name: animated-skeleton
title: Animated Skeleton
description: Placeholders that shimmer while content loads.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette for the placeholders, their shimmer and the loaded content.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: animation
props.label: Animation
props.description: Loading effect drawn across the placeholders.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: Length of one loading cycle, in seconds. Not used when Animation is None.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Offset between placeholders so they don't pulse in sync, in seconds. Not used when Animation is None.

props.name: swapAnimation
props.label: Swap animation
props.description: How the real content appears when loading finishes.

props.name: swapDuration
props.label: Content entrance duration
props.description: How long the real content takes to appear, in seconds. Not used when Swap animation is None.

props.name: swapStagger
props.label: Delay between content items
props.description: Delay between content items appearing, in seconds. Not used when Swap animation is None.

props.name: loadTime
props.label: Skeleton loading time
props.description: How long the Replay button pretends to load before showing the content, in seconds. The first load always takes 3 s.
